[P1] attack_05 — destination without a profile row raises 23503 and rolls back the source loss; source keeps premium after a provider-confirmed loss (base passes). [P1] attack_01 — a destination shared by two unsettled transfers gets premium via the other transfer's ticket while the RPC returns withheld=true AND billing.premium=true. [P1] attack_03 — held source deleted from Auth never becomes 'missing'; transfer stays held, webhook 55000 forever. ATTACKS THAT DID NOT BREAK (4, VERIFIED PASS on candidate): attack_06 concurrency (dblink second session; source-first and destination-first interleavings block on the transfer lock and finish without deadlock/error, held-release race, duplicate begin under one lease => one transfer row); attack_07 roles (anon/authenticated denied 42501 on the three api_private tables, the audit sequence, all public RPCs and every private helper; service_role allowed on the RPCs and denied direct table access; append-only guard blocks DELETE/UPDATE as superuser); attack_08 boundaries (17 subjects rejected 22023 with no durable rows, anonymous-only => no_subjects, far-future source expiry holds and far-past releases, stale older tickets neither demote the destination nor re-grant the source nor rewrite sides, conflicting re-enqueue 22023 / identical re-enqueue idempotent); attack_09 crash between steps (dead-lease completion 55000, redelivery re-verifies both sides, live-lease completion {received:true, verified:true}, audit sequence enqueued→destination_verified→destination_withheld→source_verified→destination_applied→confirmed).

implement.summary:
GAP ON BASE_SHA (INFERRED from code): the webhook path supabase/functions/api/index.ts:3874-3923 (beginBillingVerification -> verifyRevenueCatSubscriber per subject -> persistBillingVerdict -> complete_billing_webhook) treats a TRANSFER's two subjects as independent verdicts. public.persist_billing_verdict (supabase/migrations/20260907133000_ordered_api_merge_integration.sql, the ordered upsert into public.billing_entitlements) grants the destination premium the moment its own RevenueCat verdict is persisted, regardless of whether the source has been provider-confirmed as no longer entitled; nothing durable records the transfer scope, so a crash between the two persists leaves a half-applied transfer with no recovery record, and complete_billing_webhook (same file) only checks per-ticket completion, not source/destination reconciliation. No transfer queue or audit ledger existed (regression on BASE aborts at security_regression.sql:5514: relation api_private.billing_transfers does not exist).

FIX (new forward migration supabase/migrations/20260908150000_billing_recovery_transfer.sql, timestamp later than every existing one; no applied migration edited):
- Durable queue: api_private.billing_transfers (event_id unique, payload_hash bound to the webhook claim hash, source/destination uuid[] scope, state pending|held|confirmed, settled_at), api_private.billing_transfer_sides (per-subject role, ticket_id, verification_order, verdict, verified_at, applied_at, user_missing_at), api_private.billing_transfer_audit (identity id, action enum, jsonb detail). RLS enabled, no policies, ALL table+sequence privileges revoked from public/anon/authenticated/service_role -> reachable only via SECURITY DEFINER RPCs.
- Append-only: trigger api_private.guard_billing_transfer_history rejects DELETE everywhere and UPDATE on the audit (insufficient_privilege), rejects re-scoping a transfer, reopening a confirmed transfer, rewriting an applied side or regressing a side's verification_order (check_violation) — enforced even for the table owner (tested as superuser).
- public.enqueue_billing_transfer(text,jsonb,uuid) [service_role only]: validates TRANSFER shape, normalises/dedupes uuid subjects (anonymous ids ignored), rejects source/destination overlap and >16 subjects (22023), requires the caller's live webhook lease (55000 otherwise), idempotent per event_id, rejects a different payload for the same event (22023), records missing Auth users, then settles.
- public.billing_transfer_recovery(uuid) [service_role only]: unsettled transfers for a subject with per-side verified/active/applied/missing flags.
- WIRING into the shipping path without touching supabase/functions/api/index.ts (edge-index serial group not held): public.begin_billing_verification(uuid[],text,jsonb,uuid) keeps its exact contract and additionally calls enqueue_billing_transfer when payload.event.type = 'TRANSFER' under the same lease; public.persist_billing_verdict(uuid,uuid,jsonb) keeps its exact contract/return shape and reconciles against the queue: a SOURCE verdict applies immediately (source loses) and is recorded on every unsettled transfer where the user is a source; a DESTINATION verdict issued for the transfer event is recorded but its premium grant is WITHHELD until every source side is provider-confirmed inactive or authoritatively absent from Auth (barrier = api_private.settle_billing_transfer). While withheld the RPC returns applied=false, withheld=true, billing.premium=false (+transfer {id,event_id,state}), so complete_billing_webhook (unchanged: requires an entitlement row at >= the ticket's order) raises 55000 and the Edge returns 503 -> RevenueCat redelivers; on redelivery new tickets re-verify both sides and the barrier releases once the source is confirmed lost. A source that still holds the entitlement parks the transfer as `held` (never fabricates loss or gain). Destination application goes through the same ordered upsert (newest verification_order wins). A verdict the destination obtains on its own (sync, not bound to the transfer event) is provider confirmation in its own right and applies directly while still being recorded/settled on the queue.

implement.summary: W07-03 round 2 on BASE_SHA d8e5db3e. Defect/gap on base: there is no transfer queue or barrier at all — public.begin_billing_verification (supabase/migrations/20260907133000_ordered_api_merge_integration.sql:205-245) only issues tickets, public.persist_billing_verdict (20260906233000_ordered_billing_verification.sql, replaced in 20260907133000) applies any verdict straight into public.billing_entitlements, and api_private.billing_webhook_subjects (20260906233000:50-93) merely flattens transferred_from/transferred_to into one subject list, so a TRANSFER destination gains premium as soon as RevenueCat reports it active, regardless of whether the source has been confirmed lost. The r1 candidate (9459202d) added a queue but (adversary A1/A2/A3/A5) bound the barrier to the current ticket's transfer, trusted stale source verdicts, and raised 23503 from destination application inside the source's transaction. Fix (single new migration 20260908150000_billing_recovery_transfer.sql, additive, later than every existing timestamp): api_private.billing_transfers/_sides/_audit (RLS on, zero grants, append-only trigger); api_private.billing_destination_blocker(user, at) = oldest unsettled transfer where the user is a destination and some present source is unverified or still active — consulted by persist_billing_verdict for EVERY active verdict of a user who is a destination anywhere (own sync ticket, other transfer's ticket, own transfer ticket), recording the verdict on every open side and withholding the entitlement write (response applied=false, withheld=true, billing snapshot from the stored row / non-premium when none, transfer{event_id,state}); api_private.reconcile_billing_transfer_sources re-checks every source side against auth.users on each reconciliation (a deleted source is marked user_missing_at + audited source_missing{verified}), so a held transfer releases on redelivery; api_private.apply_billing_transfer_side never raises for the destination's state (absent from Auth => destination_missing; profile row absent => destination_deferred, side stays open and is retried), so the source's loss is durable; api_private.lock_billing_transfers takes all reachable transfers in id order before any entitlement write; enqueue_billing_transfer drops overlapping/scalar/anonymous parties (verified directly, as on base) so no payload shape poisons a delivery. Wired into the shipping Edge sequence without Edge changes: public.begin_billing_verification(uuid[],text,jsonb,uuid) queues TRANSFER events under the delivery lease, public.persist_billing_verdict(uuid,uuid,jsonb) reconciles against the queue, complete_billing_webhook unchanged (a withheld destination has no row at >= the ticket's order, so it raises 55000 and RevenueCat redelivers).
